beats.narration_text: Someone asked if Claude already knows how to build a Zoom REST API app. Not quite — it reads a skill file first. So here's the real question: does Claude already read the Zoom API skill?

beats.narration_text: A skill is a folder Claude reads before it works. This one is called build-zoom-rest-api-app — the reference skill for the Zoom REST API. The instructions live in one file, in plain language, no hidden logic. The file is the program.

shot.new_visual_element: The skill folder's anatomy — SKILL.md as the instruction set

props.title: A skill is a folder.
props.calloutText: The SKILL.md is the instruction set.

beats.narration_text: So does naming the skill mean Claude already knows everything about the Zoom API, out of the box? That's the natural guess — one file, and suddenly it's an expert.

shot.new_visual_element: The naive guess — one file makes Claude a Zoom expert

props.heading: So it already knows the API?
props.body: One file added → Claude just knows the Zoom API?

beats.narration_text: Open the file and the knowledge is specific, not general: endpoint selection, resource-management patterns, OAuth requirements, rate-limit awareness, API error debugging. Five things, written down — nothing broader than that.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR — the five named things the file actually covers

props.heading: Five things. Written down.
props.body: Endpoint selection. Resource-management patterns. OAuth requirements. Rate-limit awareness. API error debugging.

beats.narration_text: The instructions run in order, in the Steps section. Claude reads each step and executes it — linear, no branching unless a step says so.
Ask about those same five things twice, and Claude reads the same file twice — endpoint selection, OAuth, rate limits, and the rest, delivered the same way both times.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR RETURNS — the same five things, delivered identically

props.heading: Ask twice, same answer.
props.body: Endpoint selection. OAuth. Rate limits. Same file, every time.

beats.narration_text: Stay inside those five things and the answer repeats reliably, run after run. Step outside them — a Zoom feature the file never mentions — and the skill has nothing written to read, so the guidance stops.

shot.new_visual_element: Inside the five things vs. outside them

props.heading: Inside the file, outside the file.
props.body: Inside the five: reliable, every run. Outside them: nothing written.

beats.narration_text: Claude repeats the exact same Zoom REST API guidance every time — but only for the five things this skill actually writes down.
